name: pi-dad
description: Minimal Slack agent harness built on the pi AI libraries.

scripts.start: . ./.env && docker start ${DAD_SANDBOX_CONTAINER:?set it in .env} && node src/main.js --sandbox=docker:$DAD_SANDBOX_CONTAINER ${DAD_PROVIDER:+--provider=$DAD_PROVIDER} ${DAD_BASE_URL:+--base-url=$DAD_BASE_URL} --model="${DAD_MODEL:?set it in .env}" "${DAD_WORKSPACE:?set it in .env}"
scripts.start:host: . ./.env && node src/main.js --sandbox=host ${DAD_PROVIDER:+--provider=$DAD_PROVIDER} ${DAD_BASE_URL:+--base-url=$DAD_BASE_URL} --model="${DAD_MODEL:?set it in .env}" "${DAD_WORKSPACE:?set it in .env}"
